title: Human Bodies Release About 2 Billion Tons of CO2 a Year
paragraphs: Every person makes carbon dioxide, or CO2. We make it when our body turns food into energy. We breathe it out.
Scientists in the United Kingdom counted this CO2 for all people on Earth. In 2015, it was about 2.05 billion tons. In 1985, it was about 1.18 billion tons.
The number grew because there are more people now. The scientists say this is not the cause of climate change. It is part of nature.
